Name: Axolotl Scarecrows
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
with alternative textures, scarecrows, rarecrows and deluxe scarecrows can be turned into axolotl scarecrows in the colors pink, albino, yellow, blue, lavender and black!

≽(◕ ᴗ ◕)≼

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on any type of scarecrow to change it to the axolotl of your choosing
